title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: the top-left chevron collapses and expands every group
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • At least three vendors have overdue bills on today's date.
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST S4-04 Alder, ZZAUTOTEST S4-04 Birch, ZZAUTOTEST S4-04 Cedar.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Unpaid Invoices is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with every group collapsed.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the chevron on one vendor group row.
  2. Hover over the chevron button in the table's top-left header cell.
  3. Click that chevron button.
  4. Look at the column header under the button and at the sort mark.
  5. Hover over the chevron button again.
  6. Click it.
  7. Look at each vendor group row's own chevron.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: that vendor group expands and its own chevron turns from pointing right to pointing down.
  • Step 2: the button's chevron points down (a group is expanded) and a tooltip above the button reads "Collapse all".
  • Step 3: every group collapses.
  • Step 4: the column under the button was not sorted: the sort mark is still on the column the report opened on.
  • Step 5: the chevron now points right and the tooltip reads "Expand all".
  • Step 6: every group expands, and the column under the button is still not sorted.
  • Step 7: every vendor group row's chevron points down (open).

This release does not change how the groups open, so they open as today; the starting screen asks for every group collapsed, collapsing any that are open.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
  • S4-R3: “Clicking the button never sorts the column under it.”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Collapse all / Expand all button | "Collapse all" / "Expand all" | Tooltip above the button”
